memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports mild dyspnea on exertion, manages ADLs independently, walks to market with occasional rest.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (normal).
falls: no falls in last 12 months, gait steady, timed up-and-go 10 seconds (low fall risk).
medicines: 4 regular (orlistat, tiotropium, budesonide-formoterol, salbutamol SOS).
mood: occasional low mood, denies depression.
carers: daughter Priya, lives with patient.
goals: "I want to keep walking to the market and tend my flower stall."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
orlistat 120 mg orally with each main meal, continue
tiotropium 18 mcg inhalation once daily, continue
salbutamol 100 mcg inhalation as needed for wheeze, continue
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg inhalation twice daily, continue

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
fasting lipid profile: total cholesterol 5.2 mmol/L (<5.2), LDL 3.1 mmol/L (<2.6), HDL 1.2 mmol/L (>1.0), triglycerides 1.8 mmol/L (<1.7)
fasting glucose: 6.1 mmol/L (3.9-5.5) – impaired
HbA1c: 6.0% (4.0-5.6) – elevated
liver function: ALT 28 U/L (<40), AST 24 U/L (<40), ALP 78 U/L (<120), GGT 32 U/L (<50), bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL (<1.2)

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
spirometry: FEV1 1.68 L (58% predicted), FVC 2.30 L (78% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.73 (0.70-0.80) – consistent with moderate COPD.
chest X-ray: hyperinflated lungs, no acute infiltrate.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: penicillin: rash and pruritus within 30 minutes of oral dose – allergic reaction.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports stable dyspnea, able to walk to market with one rest stop, no new limitations.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (stable).
falls: no falls in last 12 months, gait steady, timed up-and-go 10 seconds.
medicines: 4 regular (orlistat, tiotropium, budesonide-formoterol, salbutamol SOS) plus newly added calcium and vitamin D.
mood: reports improved mood, enjoys gardening.
carers: daughter Priya, lives with patient.
goals: "I want to keep walking to the market and tend my flower stall."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
calcium carbonate 500 mg orally twice daily, continue
cholecalciferol 1000 IU orally once daily, continue

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
fasting lipid profile: total cholesterol 4.9 mmol/L (<5.2), LDL 2.8 mmol/L (<2.6), HDL 1.3 mmol/L (>1.0), triglycerides 1.6 mmol/L (<1.7)
fasting glucose: 5.8 mmol/L (3.9-5.5) – near normal
HbA1c: 5.7% (4.0-5.6) – improved
liver function: ALT 22 U/L (<40), AST 20 U/L (<40), ALP 75 U/L (<120), GGT 30 U/L (<50), bilirubin 0.8 mg/dL (<1.2)

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: notes increased shortness of breath on exertion, uses salbutamol more often, still attends market with assistance.
cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (borderline) – plan for full assessment.
falls: one fall at home 3 months ago (tripped over rug), no injury, gait slightly unsteady, timed up-and-go 13 seconds (raised fall risk) – advise exercise program and supportive footwear.
medicines: 4 regular (orlistat, tiotropium, budesonide-formoterol, salbutamol SOS) plus calcium and vitamin D.
mood: reports frustration with breathlessness, denies depression.
carers: daughter Priya, lives with patient.
goals: "I want to keep walking to the market and tend my flower stall."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
orlistat discontinued due to gastrointestinal intolerance
salbutamol 100 mcg inhalation as needed for wheeze, continue
tiotropium 18 mcg inhalation once daily, continue
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg inhalation twice daily, continue
calcium carbonate 500 mg orally twice daily, continue
cholecalciferol 1000 IU orally once daily, continue

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
chest X-ray: mild hyperinflation, no new infiltrate or effusion.
spirometry: FEV1 1.55 L (53% predicted), FVC 2.20 L (73% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.70 (borderline) – slight decline consistent with COPD progression.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling more short of breath when I walk to the flower stall, and I need to use my rescue inhaler about three times a day. I’m worried I might need extra help.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up geriatric appointment booked for 2026-03-20 at 10:00 AM with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06).
